derived.sourceText: Adding the equations gives 3x = 9, so x = 3.

qualitativeClaims.claim: On the same coordinate axes, the graphs meet at (3, 1). That point satisfies both equations: 2(3) + 1 = 7 and 3 - 1 = 2.
Rewriting the equations as y = -2x + 7 and y = x - 2 shows that their slopes differ. Two lines with different slopes intersect exactly once, so the graphs show a unique solution.
